description: This grouped vertical bar chart, captioned "Figure 7. mBERT XLM-RoBERTa comparison by language family," illustrates the performance comparison between two models across various language families. The horizontal axis displays the categorical variables, which are language families ordered from left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "task count," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines spaced at intervals of 10. The data is represented by clusters of up to three vertical bars for each language family, with the grouping visually arranged side-by-side. According to the legend titled "better," the bar colors represent which model performed better or if they tied: light blue for "mBERT," dark blue for "XLM-R," and light green for "same." All bars feature a thin black outline. The tallest bar in the chart is the dark blue "XLM-R" bar in the IE-Slavic category, reaching a value of approximately 39. Conversely, the shortest bars are the light blue "mBERT" bars in the IE-Baltic and Semitic categories, which appear to have a value of zero or near zero. The categories on the horizontal axis do not appear to be sorted by the total or individual bar heights, and no specific bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard legend colors.
